limitations: This review approves the V3 startup correction for admission; it does not assert an actual V3 launch, checkpoint load, array read, or gradient result.
The V1 import smoke receipt records zero data-reader calls, but V2 itself had already hashed/mapped the selected 24 NPYs before its checkpoint-loader failure.

review.historical_failures: V1 failure is preserved: same-process import smoke left wnn loaded, so CLI source guard raised RuntimeError before any model/gradient work; its separate import smoke passed with zero data-reader calls and no CUDA initialization. V2 failure is preserved: weights_only=True rejected TorchVersion metadata before model construction; V2 had mapped/hashed 24 sample NPYs before reaching that loader. V3 uses the narrow restricted-loader correction and fresh exec startup; those historical attempts are not results.
review.outer_preimport_source_gate: PASS: the current literal outer-body map contains all 25 canonical WNN source digests and exactly matches the 25 canonical entries in the reviewed manifest. It verifies them before systemd-run and again after staging; staged payload bytes are hash-checked on decode, on write, and in a final pre-invocation pass. The updated path gate accepts flat staged names and only the direct idea_screens_r6/records/<file> form needed for the two pinned metadata fixtures; absolute and parent-traversal paths reject.
review.resource_and_scope: PASS: V3 uses a new unique support destination, output path and unit, retaining the 50% CPU quota, 1.4 GB MemoryHigh, 1.5 GB MemoryMax, zero swap, and 600-second runtime. Outer admission checks existing campaign/resource conditions before creating the unit. The inline smoke and corrected process do not overlap; no scientific windows, loss, checkpoint identity or model design changes.
review.startup_order: PASS: the in-unit import smoke runs serially under the same unit limits. While np.load, pyarrow.parquet.ParquetFile and torch.load are denied, it imports every staged non-test R6 Python module and the deferred R1 helper, then verifies zero denied-reader calls and no CUDA initialization. It restores the readers and uses os.execv to replace the process with the clean frozen run_probe.py CLI and the same fixed sample/checkpoint/output/manifest arguments. The CLI therefore starts with an empty sys.modules and repeats its own source and payload checks before checkpoint load.

scope: Independent review of the V3 startup correction and outer admission template only. This is a prelaunch review, not evidence that V3 ran or completed.
